profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Information Technology professional with significant experience as a Software Engineer designing, developing, and implementing simple cost effective solutions towards optimizing information environments for decision-making and providing services to clients and customers.

Specialties: Skills: Systems Analysis & Design, Programming, Data Mining & Trend Analysis, Project & Data Management.

Technologies: Perl, Multi-Platform SQL, VBA/VB, Business Intelligence, Data Warehousing, C, C++, C# (C Sharp), Java, JavaScript, PHP, ASP, HTML, Flash, XML, SOAP, Internet Programming, Unix Shell Scripting, Windows Batch Files

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designing and implementing utility corporation Websites geared for mobile devices and used by utility customers for outage status inquiries and reporting.  Technologies include Java, the Spring Framework, Apache Tomcat, JavaScript, and Ajax with direct interfaces to utility client CIS and OMS systems.

Development of system-wide Web based control interfaces using Sun Solaris, Oracle databases, Java EE, JSP, JavaScript, the NetBeans IDE/Ant, Sun Application Server/Glassfish, and Apache Tomcat.

Designing and implementing client and Internet facing asynchronous Web administration pages using a template based framework, Ajax, JSON, and ExtJs.

Development and administration of production systems written in C, Perl, and Java with emphasis on socket, multithreaded programming, and protocols such as SOAP.

Administration of a LAMP system (Linux, Apache, MySQL, and PHP) extended with J2EE, Perl CGI, and Oracle connection capability used for deploying ancillary support Web interfaces for project management, tracking, and reports.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborated with business, data, and systems analysts among others across the company for financial and operational performance improvements.

Comprehensive automation of report generation from ETL to chart generation and publication. 

Evaluated and optimized deployment of solutions.

Designed, developed, deployed, and continuously improved software.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and administered enterprise-scale monitoring and alerting applications deployed and used in the new Network Operations Center (NOC) that decreased fault isolation and resolution times from hours to minutes.

Developed and administered applications used in trend analysis and justification of future capacity requirements.

Administered then later transferred responsibility of the CompuServe proprietary Enhanced Menu database systems to Systems Administrators and the NOC leveraging the 24x7 support infrastructure for improved product support.

positions.title: Systems Programmer
positions.description:
Development and implementation of monitoring and alerting systems for the CompuServe client backend database systems with the goal of minimizing downtime.

Administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, and load balancing of the CompuServe client backend database systems.

Automatic data gathering and report generation of usage statistics to help in troubleshooting, load balancing, and finding areas of improvement.

positions.title: Computer Consultant
positions.description:
C language coding of electronic tax form validation software.

Administration and ancillary program development for proprietary technology databases.
